findings.claim: The entire Goal 3 characterization (KnowMe Builder v2.0.0-alpha.1, 39 skills, three generation profiles, Rust binary) and Goal 2's pack size claim (619 SKILL.md files, plugin v1.7.0) are marked [CONFIRMED] but are unverifiable within the packet, and the packet's own path verification returned MISSING for the load-bearing evidence files.
findings.evidence: cited_paths: "MISSING  builder.manifest.json" and "MISSING  tools/knowme-builder/src/main.rs" — yet the artifact states as [CONFIRMED] that the hybrid source dir is "KnowMe Builder v2.0.0-alpha.1, with builder.manifest.json ... and a knowme-builder Rust binary (tools/knowme-builder/src/main.rs)". Goal 4 is declared BLOCKED on Goal 3's scoping, so if this external-tree reading is wrong, the analyze-stage scoping decision is built on uncorroborated evidence.
findings.suggested_fix: Attach corroborating evidence for both external trees (directory listing, builder.manifest.json excerpt, SKILL.md count output, plugin.json version) or downgrade these claims from [CONFIRMED] to UNVERIFIED so analyze treats the Goal 3 readings as hypotheses.

findings.claim: Goal 1 requires the app to be "fully operational offline/self-hosted without any account", but the assessment only examines the sign-in gate and workspace-context switch; it never surveys other cloud couplings (telemetry, update checks, default remote model endpoints, remote asset fetching) that could leave the app non-functional offline even after the gate is removed.
findings.evidence: Goal text: "the app must be fully operational offline/self-hosted without any account". The Goal 1 section covers EntryShell.tsx, OD_WORKSPACE_CONTEXT_SOURCE, the CLI, and workspace binding, and the offline-flag grep ("OD_OFFLINE|offlineMode|localOnlyMode|disableCloud|skipSignIn|SELF_HOST ... zero hits") proves only that no flag exists — it says nothing about what else phones home. The SPEC GAP SUMMARY lists 8 gaps, none covering post-gate offline operability.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a gap entry enumerating runtime network dependencies exercised in a signed-out state (model resolution, telemetry/analytics, auto-update, asset/CDN fetches) with file:line evidence, or an explicit note that this survey was performed and found none.

findings.claim: The claim that plugins/_official/scenarios/ contains od-react-export, od-nextjs-export, od-vue-export, and od-code-migration as "direct precedent" for Goal 4 is not corroborated by the packet.
findings.evidence: file_tree lists "./plugins/_official" with no visible children, and cited_paths for "od-react-export/open-design.json" shows 1404 matches whose examples are all under ".tmp/tools-pack/out/.../plugins/_official/atoms/..." (build output, atoms — not scenarios). No match in the source tree at plugins/_official/scenarios/ is shown. Goal 4's "Direct precedent exists: [CONFIRMED]" and the quoted manifest shape ("kind: scenario, scenario: downstream-export, mode: export") rest on this unverified location.
findings.suggested_fix: Cite the source-tree path of at least one scenario plugin manifest directly (e.g., ls output of plugins/_official/scenarios/) or mark the precedent claim as inferred from build outputs.

findings.claim: Goal 2 says "Detect or install the Prometheus skill system", but only the install half is gapped; no finding addresses whether/how OD would detect an existing Prometheus installation.
findings.evidence: The Goal 2 section covers install mechanics (POST /api/skills/install, od skill install, USER_SKILLS_DIR shadowing) and notes the pack "is already a Claude plugin ... installed in the user's Claude cache", but there is no [CONFIRMED]/[MISSING] finding on detection of pre-existing external skill packs — the goal's "Detect or" clause has no corresponding gap analysis.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one finding stating whether any detection mechanism exists (e.g., scanning well-known skill dirs) or explicitly scope detection out with a rationale.
